t: 忽必烈成为蒙古帝国的统治者。
te: Kublai Khan becomes ruler of the Mongol Empire.
dz: 忽必烈成为蒙古帝国的统治者。
de: Kublai Khan becomes ruler of the Mongol Empire.

t: 利沃尼亚骑士团在13世纪的都尔贝战役中遭遇了最惨重的战败.
te: The Livonian Order suffers its greatest defeat in the 13th century in the Battle of Durbe against the Grand Duchy of Li…
dz: 利沃尼亚骑士团在13世纪的都尔贝战役中遭遇了最惨重的战败.
de: The Livonian Order suffers its greatest defeat in the 13th century in the Battle of Durbe against the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.

t: 马木卢克人在巴勒斯坦的艾因·贾卢特战役中击败了蒙古人,标志着他们第一次决定性地被击败并成为了蒙…
te: The Mamluks defeat the Mongols at the Battle of Ain Jalut in Palestine, marking their first decisive defeat and the poi…
dz: 马木卢克人在巴勒斯坦的艾因·贾卢特战役中击败了蒙古人,标志着他们第一次决定性地被击败并成为了蒙古帝国最大扩张的地步.
de: The Mamluks defeat the Mongols at the Battle of Ain Jalut in Palestine, marking their first decisive defeat and the point of maximum expansion of the Mongol Empire.

t: 西西里国王曼弗雷德所支持的西内斯·吉贝林人于蒙塔佩蒂击败了弗洛伦丁·盖尔夫斯.
te: The Sienese Ghibellines, supported by the forces of Manfred, King of Sicily, defeat the Florentine Guelphs at Montapert…
dz: 西西里国王曼弗雷德所支持的西内斯·吉贝林人于蒙塔佩蒂击败了弗洛伦丁·盖尔夫斯.
de: The Sienese Ghibellines, supported by the forces of Manfred, King of Sicily, defeat the Florentine Guelphs at Montaperti.

t: 老普鲁士人中伟大的普鲁士起义开始于铁道骑士.
te: The Great Prussian Uprising among the old Prussians begins against the Teutonic Knights.
dz: 老普鲁士人中伟大的普鲁士起义开始于铁道骑士.
de: The Great Prussian Uprising among the old Prussians begins against the Teutonic Knights.

t: 夏特雷斯大教堂由法国国王路易九世出席.
te: Chartres Cathedral is dedicated in the presence of King Louis IX of France.
dz: 夏特雷斯大教堂由法国国王路易九世出席.
de: Chartres Cathedral is dedicated in the presence of King Louis IX of France.

te: After defeating the Mongols at the Battle of Ain Jalut and assassinating the previous Mamluk sultan, Qutuz, Baybars asc…
dz: 在艾因·贾卢特战役中击败了蒙古人并刺杀前作"马姆卢克苏丹"克图兹后,拜巴尔斯以"马姆卢克苏丹国"的第四任苏丹身份登上埃及王位.
de: After defeating the Mongols at the Battle of Ain Jalut and assassinating the previous Mamluk sultan, Qutuz, Baybars ascends to the Egyptian throne as the fourth sultan of the Mamluk Sultanate.
